baseline_rules: Freeze source commit plus instrumentation-only patch and signed private binary before production fixes.
Never execute the historical broad-pkill/debug-dump runner.
One exact child process group at a time, Luna only, public evidence local0600.
Account/form/local lanes are pending until their user session or independent oracle/qualified runner exists.
Source audits must record explicit predicate evidence and reviewer type; no ungrounded LLM judge.
